semiconductor_relevance: High — Ferrotec supplies high-purity materials and components essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Ferrotec manufactures high-purity materials, including quartz, ceramics, and silicon parts, for semiconductor manufacturing equipment. They also provide vacuum feedthroughs, thermoelectric modules, and various semiconductor substrates, catering to a wide range of industries such as electronics and automotive.
capabilities: High-purity quartz products for semiconductor processes

regional_presence.Japan: Ferrotec Power Semiconductor Japan Corp. focuses on power semiconductor substrates.
